auth: while nobody has an account: a visitor at home, anyone in the first 15 minutes after the server started, or the setup link's secret in the header X-Share-Setup
notes: Sets up the storage folder, as share init does, and has the server start for real on the same port; for a moment nothing answers. Errors: 403 setup_closed, 500 setup_failed with the reason in message, such as a folder Share may not write to.
